blocks.text: A project has an end date. We build the brand and the site, hand it over, and it's yours. Membership is for what comes after, or instead of it. $4,500 a month keeps one active request moving, and you pause any month you don't need us.

blocks.text: It's a real starting number, not a teaser. Scope is the only thing that moves it: an extra page, a second brand direction, a deadline that needs two of us. We lock the figure on the first call and it holds from there.
